title: Conditional Topomorphic Degree and Multivariate Mean Equicontinuity for Minimal Amenable Group Actions
summary: Let $G$ be a countably infinite discrete amenable group acting minimally on a compact metric space $X$, and let $π:X\to X_{\mathrm{eq}}$ be the maximal equicontinuous factor map. We introduce the \emph{conditional topomorphic degree} $d:=\tdeg_G(X)\in\mathbb N\cup\{\infty\}$, which, when finite, is the least integer such that $π$ is an at most $d$-to-one topomorphic extension. We prove that, for every $r\ge2$, Weyl mean $r$-equicontinuity, mean $r$-equicontinuity along some Følner sequence, and $d\le r-1$ are equivalent.
